people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces; for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.
translations.bsb: For Mordecai exercised great power in the palace, and his fame spread throughout the provinces as he became more and more powerful.
translations.kjv: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces: for this man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
translations.asv: For Mordecai was great in the king's house, and his fame went forth throughout all the provinces; for the man Mordecai waxed greater and greater.
